_about: G. W. F. Hegel (1770-1831) in English, translator per row. Named hegel-translations because the reading-lists thread (PR #22) already has a hegel shelf holding Dyde's Philosophy of Right (1896), which is not duplicated here. Clean Gutenberg: Wallace's Logic (from the Encyclopaedia, 2nd ed., Oxford, 1892) and Philosophy of Mind (Oxford, 1894), Osmaston's Philosophy of Fine Art (Bell, 1920, 4 vols.). Raw IA OCR: Haldane and Simson's Lectures on the History of Philosophy (Kegan Paul, 1892-1896, 3 vols., the first printings; Gutenberg's text of the same translation is set from a 1955 reprint and is not used), Sibree's Lectures on the Philosophy of History (Bohn, 1881), Baillie's Phenomenology of Mind (Swan Sonnenschein, 1910, 2 vols.), and Speirs and Sanderson's Lectures on the Philosophy of Religion (Kegan Paul, 1895, 3 vols.). All published before 1930, so US public domain under the US rule (decision 22); Baillie died 1940 and Osmaston's dates are unchecked, so some are not public domain in life+70 countries. Bosanquet's Introduction to the Philosophy of Fine Art is held on singles-arts-miscellany (PG 46330) and is not taken again. No uids minted.
